savedCredentials: Saved credentials are retained when these fields are left blank. Enter a replacement only to change them.
headersRequired: Enter both a name and value for each header.
consoleUrlInvalid: Use an HTTPS console URL without credentials.
openBlocked: Paperclip couldn’t open sign-in. Use the sign-in link below to continue.
connectFailed: Could not connect. Please try again.
accessLoadFailed: Could not load saved access. Retry before changing this connection.
invalidUrlBody: Paste the complete server URL, including {{httpsScheme}} or {{httpScheme}}. A dashboard page is not an MCP endpoint.
credentialsRejectedHelp: Check or replace the credentials from {{provider}}, then reconnect. Your agent access and tool choices are preserved.
unreachable: Paperclip could not reach this server
unreachableHelp: Check that the endpoint is running and reachable from Paperclip, then try again. Your draft is still here.
waitingHelp: Complete sign-in in the provider window, then return here. Paperclip is waiting for confirmation.
openAgainHelp: If a window did not open, <0/>.
cancelled: Connection cancelled. Your setup details are preserved; try again when you are ready.
reuseHelp: Use an existing connection or connect a new account. Existing access stays unchanged.
externalAccountHelp: {{provider}} is an external service that handles the connection and requests to {{app}}. Reusing this account does not yet verify app access; the agent will check it and guide any additional authorization.
